newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: New Zealand dollar closes steady ahead of election.
newsitem.headline: New Zealand dollar closes steady ahead of election.

text.p: The New Zealand dollar closed almost unchanged on Friday as investors tidied up their positions ahead of Saturday's general election.
"The market is pretty square, so that's the reason why there's been no volatility," a dealer said.
The Kiwi closed at US$0.6914/21 and at 66.05 on its Trade-Weighted Index, having traded a 0.6910-20 range during the session. It opened at 0.6916/23 and at 66.04 on the TWI.
Dealers said local selling in early trade had been met by both domestic and offshore bids.

"There were people taking back shorts before the election, but all in all it was relatively quiet and I would be very surprised if we move outside of 0.6905-25 through to the New York close," said a chief dealer.

Recent polls suggest the conservative National government could be ousted by the centre-left opposition parties if they are able to stitch together a viable coalition under the new system of proportional representation.
The chief dealer noted that although the Kiwi had fallen about one U.S. cent in the past two weeks, it was still strong in a relative sense prior to an election that was clouded in uncertainty.

"The common view that I get thrown at me is that whoever wins, be it a National-led coalition or a Labour-led coalition, they (investors) don't see too much changing in terms of economic direction," he said.
"I think the market seems to be a bit ambivalent to the whole thing, which I personally disagree with. I think there could be some interesting surprises in terms of changes to policies."
Another dealer said that the currency would rally on a National victory, but fall on its defeat.

"If it looks like it's going to be a left-wing coalition, you're probably likely to see Kiwi off 80 points. If it looks centre, centre-right, you're probably back up to 70 (U.S. cents) pretty quickly," he said.
But dealers stressed that the election outcome may be several weeks in the making, and said the Kiwi could be in for a bumpy ride. Overnight range: 0.6900-30.
